validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="1st" expr="0"/>
    <data id="max tries" expr="3"/>
    <data id="$price" expr="10"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="buy" cond="$price > 5" target="b">
      <log label="first" expr="1st"/>
    </transition>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: identifier `1st` is not an XML NCName
notes: SCXML IDs are XML IDs: they must start with a letter or `_` and contain only NCName characters (no spaces or colons), so references can be tokenized unambiguously. An `id` is `xsd:ID`, whose white space collapses (XML Schema 1.1 Part 2 §4.3.6), so leading and trailing white space is not part of it: `id=" s "` declares `s`
diagnostics.help: a `<data id>` is both an XML ID and an ECMAScript variable name: use ASCII letters, digits, and `_`, starting with a letter

fixes.message: rename the variable to `v1st` here and in 1 reference

diagnostics.message: ecmascript syntax error in `expr`: a number is immediately followed by a letter, `$`, or `_`
notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: separate the number from the name that follows it, or start the name with a letter
